name: Food Bill Assistance for Medical & Engineering Students of Nomadic Tribes & Denotified Tribes
benefit: - Monthly assistance up to ₹1,500/- for 10 months per academic year.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should belong to a Notified Tribe or De‑Notified Tribe (NTDNT) community of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be pursuing a Medical or Engineering degree course within the state of Gujarat. 1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-.
